title: The CLEF-2026 FinMMEval Lab: Multilingual and Multimodal Evaluation of Financial AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark includes a task for evaluating knowledge of Shari'ah-compliant financial reasoning, as part of a broader assessment of financial understanding.
findings: This paper describes the setup for a future benchmark (CLEF-2026 FinMMEval Lab) and does not present experimental results or findings. One of the datasets incorporated into the benchmark, SAHM, is designed to evaluate models on Arabic financial and Shari'ah-compliant reasoning.
